answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 33414 Country: Bangladesh Title: Internet Browse Question: When we browse internet for mail checking or chat or varieties work then we can see some naughty (female) picture. But always we need to check our mail or others to use internet. In this situation are we permitted to browse internet? Answer ID: 33414 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 218/218/M=1432) It is not forbidden to open internet for lawful jobs. It is allowed. However, it is forbidden to look unlawful pictures knowingly. One should avoid it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
